[USER] User is interested in effective ways to alleviate stress and anxiety through yoga.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deep Breathing is one of the most effective ways to calm down the nervous system and alleviate stress and anxiety naturally.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Deep breathing techniques include pranayama, kapalbhati, ujjayi, and bhramari.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Meditation can help achieve a sense of peace and tranquility by calming the mind and reducing negative thoughts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Best yoga poses for anxiety and stress relief include Child's Pose, Downward Dog, Tree Pose, and Corpse Pose.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Yoga Nidra, also known as “yogic sleep,” is a guided meditation that promotes restful sleep and helps release stress and anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mindful movement, such as slow vinyasa flow or hatha yoga, can decrease muscle tension and help you feel relaxed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Repeating positive affirmations can help shift your mindset and reduce anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested affirmations include: "I am calm and centered," "I release all my worries and anxieties," "I am in control of my thoughts and emotions," "I trust in my ability to handle any situation," "I am grateful for this present moment and all that it has to offer," "I am surrounded by love and positivity," "I am strong and capable of overcoming any challenge," "I am at peace with myself and the world around me," "I am confident in my abilities and trust in the universe's plan for me," "I am deserving of love and happiness, and I allow myself to receive it."  
[USER] User plans to incorporate meditation and affirmations into their yoga practice.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for ensuring correct yoga poses include:
